file_data.notes:
Down to 11000 calBP this is based on Adophi and Muscheler, 2016.
From 11000 calBP to 45000 calBP it is based on Adolphi et al. 2018.
The value at 11000 calBP is an average of the values from these two papers.
From 45000 the uncertainties are based on counting errors from Svensson et al. 2008.
The uncertainties quoted are 1/4 of the 95% probability range or 1/2 of the counting uncertainty.
